description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

The first thing he learned was patience. The second was where to put the powder.

Spend 1 Investiture and place a Charge on an object, character, or 5 ft square in Attunement Range. Declare its trigger when you place it (default: start of your next turn; alternatives include "when target moves," "when target takes damage," or "when a character enters this square"). You may detonate any of your Charges as a Free Action on your turn. When a Charge detonates, each character within 10 ft takes [Tier][Die] energy damage and the detonation point becomes dangerous terrain for the scene. You may sustain up to your tier Charges; unused Charges fizzle at the end of the scene.
